wall_name: Rare-book room (Stanza degli antichi), table close-up of an open volume
notes: Not a shelf shot but an open-book close-up with a clearly legible running page header 'THESAURUS ANAT[OMICUS]' and 'TABULA [numeral]' caption beneath an anatomical engraving. This corroborates the Italian captions around this timestamp, where a granddaughter recalls 'il tesaurus anatomicus' and 'il giardino degli scheletri' (skeleton engravings with injected/branch-like vessels, seen in later closeups at 890-930s). Author attributed to Frederik Ruysch by standard bibliographic identification of this title, not printed on the visible page itself, so author confidence is medium-high rather than certain. A gilt leather spine is held/shown a few seconds earlier (t_001404) but its tooled title is too blurred/backlit to transcribe (see skipped list).
